title: The visual check's early before has a deadline a cold site container can meet
steps: S1: draw a picture with the cold deadline through the site's own browser.
S2: draw it where the site has no browser, through dsh's host fallback.
S3: ask the view store for an early picture and for a held one.
S4: build the browser argv with no deadline, the 16 s view deadline and the 40 s cold deadline.
expect: S1: the script gets 40 s; the in-container backstop and the docker client both outlast it.
S2: dsh's browser gets the same 40 s.
S3: only the early picture reaches the capture as patient; a held picture keeps the 16 s deadline.
S4: 25 s backstop for the first two; above 40 s for the cold one.
evidence: Beta report 28/10/2026 2c; local stand 29/10/2026: the first turn on a just-started WordPress and Joomla site ended TRACY_BROWSER ERR timed out after 21.6 s

cmd: --test-name-pattern=a picture nobody waits on has the cold deadline|draw passes `patient` to the capture only when asked|the in-container backstop outlasts a deadline
tests: captureView: a picture nobody waits on has the cold deadline, on the site browser and on dsh's
createViewStore: draw passes `patient` to the capture only when asked, and only for the check
browserArgv: the in-container backstop outlasts a deadline longer than its own default
